risk_note: F1-07ee. apps/admin only (pages/orders/OrderDetailPage.tsx, pages/orders/detail-writes/, texts/orders.ts). Full order detail page write entries (hold / unhold, reason-sub, assign) by permission point; result-unknown writes lock and allow only the same-body retry; the order result-unknown marker blocks new writes after a reload, offers a confirmed 放弃这次提交 only while no write of the order is in flight, and the page rereads before unlocking once the marker goes; unknown status codes show 状态更新中 and hide every write entry. 3 frozen blocks changed as rule_change (D10-1733) with the reverse check. No contract, money computation or db change.
